scientific_limitations: Universal exact upper-tail and induced-matching recovery applies to finite connected simple unit-edge graphs with vertex diameter at most two; the full squared-tent comparison applies to the 4x4 rook and Shrikhande graph only. title: Exact arclength-distance separation of the Shrikhande and rook metric graphs
